discoveries.name: NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDING_LADDER
source_level_observations: Robbie v1.2 separates same physical subject from represented identity and permits represented_identity=null.
Fallout v2.4 states DAD_ROLE_BASE != EXACT_JAMES_PLACED_REF and ROLE_BOUND_CANDIDATE != PERSISTED_MEMORY_STATE.
Linear A bridge establishes 686 document identities while explicitly denying content/transcription/decipherment promotion.
SCOBY requires identity and incorporation evidence before attributing mechanical improvement or making application claims.

relation_to_prior_connection.delta: The earlier invariant is sequential. HIDDEN-001 adds a multi-level non-transitivity law: each binding layer is a distinct evidence type and cannot be promoted transitively.

discoveries.why_a_human_may_miss_it: The four lines use unrelated nouns—actor/identity, pod/reference, document/transcription, chitin/mechanics—while the same non-transitive binding graph is hidden underneath.
discoveries.next_falsifier: Blind the domain nouns, preserve only the binding-level graph, and test whether matched unrelated JSON ladders recover the same non-transitive adjacency more often than a schema-matched null.

discoveries.name: AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_STATE

cross_domain_instantiations.visual_identity: represented_identity may be null when roles/personas do not resolve one-vs-many narrative identity
cross_domain_instantiations.fallout_forensics: if multiple Dad-role placements survive, preserve ambiguity and do not force a unique James pod
cross_domain_instantiations.linear_a: 116 unmatched SigLA identifiers remain unresolved/excluded rather than receiving ad hoc mappings
cross_domain_instantiations.scoby_materials: competing explanations remain live; low chitin or mechanics-only effects remain unresolved rather than assigned to chitin

discoveries.why_a_human_may_miss_it: Null, candidate sets, unmatched residue and competing hypotheses look like four different kinds of incompleteness; structurally they implement the same anti-forced-choice operator.
discoveries.next_falsifier: Construct matched records where a unique answer is available and test whether the ambiguity-preservation operator disappears only when uniqueness evidence is injected.

discoveries.name: FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENERALIZES_BEYOND_VISUAL_SCORING

cross_domain_instantiations.fallout: base-role evidence passes while exact placed REFR remains OPEN and persisted state remains NOT_ESTABLISHED
cross_domain_instantiations.linear_a: document identity bridge passes while content/transcription/decipherment remain blocked
cross_domain_instantiations.scoby: G0 identity -> G2 structure -> G3 mechanics -> application; missing identity blocks attribution even when mechanics move

discoveries.relation_to_existing_method: The Robbie protocol states that first_break is more informative than an aggregate semantic score. Full-corpus comparison suggests that this diagnostic principle applies to evidence ladders generally.
discoveries.why_a_human_may_miss_it: Only Robbie names the field first_break; the other domains encode the same object as admission ladders, current matrices, epistemic gates or gating sequences.
discoveries.next_falsifier: Define a domain-neutral boundary-chain schema and compare its diagnostic loss against single aggregate scoring on held-out registry families.

discoveries.name: IRREVERSIBILITY_WEIGHTED_GATE_STRENGTH

cross_domain_instantiations.system_safety: Last Meter of Causality moves responsibility to the last object actually affected, not merely the internal reasoning boundary.
cross_domain_instantiations.human_agency: Human mediation can carry causal influence without turning the person into an actuator owned by the system.
cross_domain_instantiations.animal_welfare: simulation first; justify only residual live uncertainty; burden of proof belongs to escalation toward a living subject.

discoveries.why_a_human_may_miss_it: One source talks about output-side effects, another about human agency, and another about animal-research ethics. Their shared directionality appears only after ordering actions by external irreversibility.
confounders: all three artifacts share the same broader JANUS design culture
ethical and technical gates are not interchangeable
this is an architectural analogy, not an empirical law
discoveries.next_falsifier: Search held-out registry families for counterexamples where irreversible actuation is admitted with weaker evidence than reversible internal steps under otherwise comparable safety semantics.

meta_insight.name: THE_REGISTRY_IS_BECOMING_A_GRAPH_OF_EVIDENCE_TYPES_NOT_ONLY_A_GRAPH_OF_TOPICS
meta_insight.statement: The strongest hidden recurrences are increasingly about transformations between evidence states—identity, binding, ambiguity, admission, effect—rather than shared subject matter.
meta_insight.caution: This is an internal architectural observation over one repository with substantial common authorship. It does not establish a universal scientific law.
